calls.title: Entrata/Yardly by Taylor Morrison Utilities Scoping Call
calls.brief: The Entrata team met with Taylor Morrison and Graystar representatives to discuss the implementation of Entrata's resident utility product and other services for their build-to-rent properties, focusing on scoping the project, addressing concerns about the transition from Conservice, and planning for an upcoming onsite meeting to explore the software's functionality and integration with their existing systems. Key discussion points included utility billing processes, data migration, reporting needs, and the overall resident lifecycle within the Entrata platform, with a strong emphasis on streamlining processes and improving budgeting accuracy. The team also discussed the possibility of leveraging Graystar's existing Entrata setup as a baseline for implementation.

calls.title: Mainstreet | Entrata - Initial Pricing Regroup + Next Steps
calls.brief: Trevor and Nathan from Entrata, along with Anthony from Mainstreet Equity Corp., discussed Entrata's new hyper-AI focused platform and Mainstreet's current strategy of addressing specific operational pain points with specialized AI modules rather than a full ERP migration. While Anthony acknowledged Entrata's open API environment and advanced AI capabilities, he expressed concerns about the cost and feasibility of a full core system transfer at this time, preferring to focus on immediate solutions for call centers, CRM, and inspections. Both parties agreed to maintain communication, with Entrata offering to keep Mainstreet informed of their technological advancements for future consideration.

calls.title: Entrata Demo pre-call: Connor/Julia
calls.brief: Jen and Connor from Entrata, along with Julia from Mainstreet Equity Corp., discussed Mainstreet's current tech stack, pain points with Yardi, and interest in AI-powered solutions for leasing, invoice processing, and marketing automation. Mainstreet is seeking a smoother online application process, better reporting capabilities, and more efficient marketing management, particularly for updating property information and lead source attribution. Entrata highlighted its integrated platform, AI capabilities, and strengths in student housing management as potential solutions.

They addressed concerns about a potential $5,000 annual integration fee, explaining it's an Entrata-wide charge for their "incubator" tier, not per client, and offered to explore waiving it if it's a major blocker. The conversation concluded with a plan to involve an Entrata engineer to finalize integration details and provide pricing for Entrata's internal screening options, aiming for a swift resolution due to "deal fatigue."

calls.title: CLV | Entrata - Summit Release
calls.brief: Callin, Jen, Nathan and Stephanie from Entrata, along with Jeff from CLV Group, discussed Entrata's upcoming AI-powered releases, including new AI functionality, a proprietary LLM called "Forge," and tools for clients to build custom agents and workflows. Jeff expressed concerns about potential limitations and the desire for full autonomy in leveraging the platform, which Entrata addressed by emphasizing their commitment to providing open access to data and offering expert support to help CLV Group achieve their automation goals. The call concluded with an agreement to schedule a deep-dive technical meeting to address Jeff's concerns and configure the system for CLV Group's specific needs.

calls.title: InterRent + Entrata
calls.brief: Connor, Stephanie and Jen from Entrata, along with Jeff from InterRent/CLV Group, discussed a potential partnership focused on automating InterRent/CLV Group's property management system to achieve significant efficiency gains and scalability, with Entrata offering to provide a detailed analysis and business case demonstrating the value of switching platforms. Jeff emphasized the need for contractual guarantees to ensure the realization of promised savings, and Entrata expressed willingness to explore commercial language to protect InterRent/CLV Group's interests. The meeting concluded with plans for Entrata to gather necessary information and develop a presentation outlining potential automation opportunities and a timeline for moving forward.

calls.title: Entrata Overview Demo: InterRent
calls.brief: Jen, Nathan and Connor from Entrata, along with Jeff from InterRent/CLV Group, discussed Entrata's platform capabilities, focusing on its unified data layer, AI-driven automation for leasing and resident operations, and integration potential. Key highlights included Entrata's mobile-first approach, customizable leasing journeys, and advanced AI agents designed to streamline business processes and reduce manual intervention, with a planned in-person meeting in Utah to delve deeper into specific objectives. The conversation also touched upon Entrata's robust partnership program and the potential for enhanced automation in Canada, particularly concerning legal forms and resident lifecycle management.

calls.title: Entrata Pre-Demo Call
calls.brief: Connor and Jen from Entrata, along with Jeff from InterRent/CLV Group, discussed InterRent's need for a PMS solution that offers significant cost savings, improved efficiencies, and seamless integrations, particularly emphasizing a mobile-first approach and open platform capabilities to justify switching from Yardi. Entrata is tailoring a demo and Utah visit to address these concerns, focusing on their mobile strategy, integration capabilities, and implementation process, while also acknowledging the sensitivity around discussing a potential switch with Jeff's team. The call concluded with plans for a follow-up dinner in Utah to further explore the partnership.

calls.title: Entrata + InterRent/CLV: Sync
calls.brief: Connor and Nathan from Entrata, along with Jeff from InterRent/CLV Group, discussed Entrata's platform capabilities, particularly regarding automation and AI features, and explored potential integration and partnership opportunities. Key highlights included a deep dive into Entrata's leasing AI, the possibility of developing a proprietary resident app, and planning for Jeff's upcoming visit to Entrata's Utah headquarters to further discuss a long-term strategic partnership. They also touched upon Entrata's Canadian client base and the potential for introductions to companies with similar operational needs.

calls.title: Entrata + CLV/InterRent: Transition Overview
calls.brief: Nathan, Callin and Connor from Entrata, along with Jeff from InterRent/CLV Group, discussed InterRent/CLV Group's potential transition to Entrata's property management system, focusing on implementation processes, data migration strategies, training, and the potential for automation to reduce labor costs. Entrata emphasized its "white glove" service, customizable training, and the availability of 24/7 support, while InterRent/CLV Group expressed interest in a phased implementation, data extraction from their Yardi replica, and references from other clients who have successfully automated workflows and reduced labor after switching to Entrata. The parties agreed to continue discussions and explore a potential visit to Entrata's headquarters.

calls.title: Entrata | SPM Migration discussion
calls.brief: Katiuska and Ryan from Entrata, along with Holly, Melina and Griffin from SPM Property Management, discussed a variance in financial data, which was identified as a midstream acquisition issue. Ryan's team implemented a coding fix that resolved the underlying problem, allowing for accurate data reconciliation and eliminating the need for further manual adjustments by SPM Property Management. The call concluded with a commitment to continued progress and a positive outlook on future iterations of the process.

calls.title: Entrata+SPM Implementation Touchpoint
calls.brief: Entrata team members, along with Melina, Taniesha and Sam, discussed the upcoming migration of SPM Property Management's data to Entrata, focusing on historical data requirements, training schedules, and website updates. A key point of discussion was the historical certification data needed for affordable properties, with a minimum requirement of three years, and the team also addressed concerns about call routing and phone system integration with Eli Plus. The group also discussed the need for privacy policies and TCPA compliance on property websites, and the creation of merchant accounts.

calls.title: SPM<>Entrata CSM Weekly Call
calls.brief: Kevin and Liana from Entrata, along with Will, Erika, Melina, Sam and Taniesha, discussed pricing issues for SPM properties, specifically regarding bulk unit space pricing for amenities and bed space premiums. They also addressed Sam's questions about space configuration and roommate matching, and Liana committed to providing updates and resources to assist with training and implementation. Finally, they touched on the availability of a test database and upcoming training materials.

calls.title: Entrata / Carter-Haston: Fee Transparency Demo
calls.brief: Dan and Jen from Entrata, along with Allyson, Ariel and Nicole from Carter-Haston Real Estate Services, discussed Entrata's fee transparency features and how they address increasing regulatory requirements and Carter-Haston's specific concerns about managing fees across multiple platforms. The Entrata team demonstrated the system's capabilities, including a cost estimation calculator, centralized fee management, and integration with ILSs, aiming to provide a unified and automated solution for displaying fees and ensuring compliance. Carter-Haston expressed interest in Entrata's proactive approach and the potential for streamlining their current processes, with plans to further evaluate the system and determine next steps.

calls.title: SPM<>Entrata CSM Weekly Call
calls.brief: Kevin, Liana and Jason from Entrata, along with Melina, Will, Taniesha, Brenda, Sam and Erika, discussed resolving historical access issues for Rise Lakeview properties, specifically addressing discrepancies between residential and commercial units. They also explored options for additional BI consulting hours and a potential feature request regarding space configuration for student housing, focusing on roommate matching challenges. Finally, they touched on upcoming internal discussions regarding data mapping and concluded the meeting with action items for both teams.

calls.title: SPM<>Entrata CSM Weekly Call
calls.brief: Jason, Kevin and Liana from Entrata, along with Melina, Brenda, Sam, Brandon, Taniesha, Erika and Will, discussed resolving an issue with deactivating "ellis" for historical access, which was being blocked by an active invoice processing contract. They also addressed numerous feature requests submitted by SPM Property Management, with Entrata agreeing to organize and prioritize them. Additionally, Sam requested admin access for BI and discussed the activation of a "home body addendum" for new leases, seeking a report of unsigned addendums to ensure smooth move-ins and billing.

calls.title: Entrata / SPM - Scoping & Training discussion
calls.brief: Entrata team members, along with Sam and Mitchell, discussed the upcoming implementation of Entrata's software for Carter-Haston Real Estate Services, focusing on training strategies, data migration challenges, and the specific needs of affordable housing properties. Key highlights included the preference for in-person consultations and training, the importance of data cleanliness for successful migration, and a proposed phased approach to implementation starting with a small group of affordable housing properties. The discussion also touched upon the integration of Carter-Haston's accounting functions, including their third-party provider Alpha Creek, into the Entrata system.

calls.title: SPM<>Entrata CSM Weekly Call
calls.brief: Jason and Liana from Entrata, along with Brandon, Melina, Sam, Will, Brenda and Taniesha, discussed the rollout of Homebody across Carter-Haston's conventional properties, upcoming training initiatives, and potential integrations with Entrata's BI tool. Key action items included addressing SEO issues impacting Carter-Haston's websites, resolving a reporting parameter bug, and coordinating a meeting with the new Migrations Manager. Liana also provided updates on bug fixes and upcoming releases, while Sam confirmed the successful implementation of positive pay.

calls.title: Entrata / SPM - Rent Reporting support
calls.brief: Liana, Kevin and Alyssa from Entrata, along with Sam from Carter-Haston Real Estate Services, discussed RentPlus integration and enrollment processes, focusing on resolving immediate access issues and planning for automated enrollment in August. They agreed to delay automatic enrollment until August 1st, continue marketing campaigns, and provide Carter-Haston with necessary access and information for managing the program, including a dedicated CSM. The team also addressed concerns about resident communication and the need for granular user permissions within the system.

calls.title: SPM<>Entrata CSM Weekly Call
calls.brief: Liana and Kevin from Entrata, along with SPM Property Management team members, discussed the transition from Yardi to Entrata, focusing on training needs, support resources, and the implementation of Homebody. SPM expressed excitement and commitment to the transition, emphasizing the importance of Entrata's team and potential for growth, particularly in the affordable housing sector. Key action items included scheduling training calls for utilities and UEM, resolving Homebody implementation issues, and exploring revenue management solutions.

calls.title: SPM Rent Reporting Consultation
calls.brief: Anthony and Kevin from Entrata, along with SPM Property Management team members, discussed the implementation of Entrata's rent reporting product, Homebody, for student properties, focusing on enrollment models, billing, and launch requirements with a go-live date set for January 2nd. The team agreed to include the rent reporting addendum in lease packets as an optional feature, and SPM will handle the GL code setup and credit bureau data verification form. They also discussed the possibility of expanding the program to conventional sites in the future, pending approval.

calls.brief: Nick from Entrata and Alexis from APIS Management discussed Entrata's software capabilities, focusing on Alexis's key pain points including ease of use for staff and clients, efficient property and staff onboarding, and robust reporting. Alexis expressed significant dissatisfaction with RealPage, highlighting Entrata's potential advantages in integrated features like renovation tracking and a vendor portal, and expressed interest in Entrata's approach to onboarding and its open ecosystem for custom dashboards. The conversation also touched upon Entrata's potential to partner with APIS Management's co-op listing service, Cooperative Shares.com.

calls.title: Entrata/Shape: Sync
calls.brief: Connor from Entrata, along with Jessica from Shape Properties, discussed the ongoing contract negotiations, primarily focusing on Entrata's "pad fees" which are a point of contention for Shape Properties due to competitor pricing and their aggressive growth strategy. While Entrata argues the platform's long-term operational efficiencies will offset these fees, Jessica is seeking reassurance and potential adjustments to the fee structure to facilitate the deal, with both parties agreeing to explore internal options and reconvene.

calls.title: Connor/Jessica: Entrata Sync
calls.brief: Connor from Entrata, along with Jessica from Shape Properties, discussed finalizing the sales order agreement for Entrata's software bundle, including pricing, contract terms, and implementation details for Shape Properties' properties. They agreed on a timeline for legal review and DocuSign signing, and scheduled a follow-up meeting with Shape Properties' marketing team to discuss Entrata's marketing tools and capabilities.

calls.title: Shape: Entrata Leasing Demo
calls.brief: Libby and Connor from Entrata, along with Arthur from Shape Properties, discussed Entrata's platform capabilities for managing Shape Properties' 3,000 units, focusing on leasing, appointment scheduling, application processes, and lease generation, with an emphasis on customization and automation. Key concerns raised by Shape Properties included the flexibility of intake forms, the ability to customize applications, and the integration of pet information into the scheduling process, all of which will be further explored in future demos. The call concluded with a plan to schedule an AI-focused demo and an on-site visit to address any remaining questions and ensure Entrata aligns with Shape Properties' specific needs.

calls.title: Accounting Demo for Heritage Hill
calls.brief: James and Seth from Entrata, along with Chris, Kaelin and Sean from Heritage Hill Property Management, discussed Entrata's accounting and reporting capabilities, focusing on AP automation, vendor management, fixed asset tracking, and customizable reporting features, with a particular emphasis on how Entrata could address Heritage Hill's pain points with RealPage. The conversation also touched on advanced budgeting, potential integration with Heritage Hill's existing systems, and the possibility of outsourcing invoice processing to Entrata. The group agreed to a follow-up session to delve deeper into advanced budgeting and business intelligence functionalities.

calls.title: Entrata BI & Data Share for Heritage Hill
calls.brief: Seth, Erick and James from Entrata, along with Sean and Chris from Heritage Hill Property Management, discussed Entrata's advanced budgeting and BI tools, with Heritage Hill primarily interested in data share capabilities for their existing Fabric environment. While impressed with Entrata's BI, Heritage Hill is undecided on replacing their current system and will focus on exploring the data share option first, with a potential on-site visit from Entrata to further discuss operational aspects. The next call will focus on operations, renewals, maintenance, and resident apps.

calls.title: Kaelin & James ROI calculator inputs
calls.brief: James from Entrata, along with Kaelin from Heritage Hill Property Management, discussed Entrata's potential solutions for Heritage Hill's budgeting, ROI tracking, and property management needs, including advanced budgeting models, rent reporting, insurance options, and vacant cost recovery. They also explored how Entrata's data-centric approach could improve accountability and data integrity, particularly in relation to Heritage Hill's "value engine" initiative and the management of both conventional and affordable properties. The conversation focused on understanding Heritage Hill's current processes and identifying areas where Entrata could provide value and streamline operations, with a plan to continue the discussion and demos in the coming weeks.

calls.title: Entrata & Core Property Capital: Accounting
calls.brief: Seth and Jun from Entrata, along with Ashley from Core Property Capital, discussed Entrata's accounting capabilities, integration with existing systems, and data migration processes, with Core Property Capital expressing interest in Entrata's detailed functionality and potential for improved connectivity compared to their current Appfolio contract. Entrata offered further demos focusing on marketing, lead-to-lease, and resident management to provide a comprehensive view of the platform.

calls.title: Call with Core Property Capital - Ashley Nichols
calls.brief: Jun spoke with Ashley to understand Core Property Capital's needs as they bring multifamily management in-house, focusing on their priority of accounting and the team's lack of experience with multifamily accounting systems. Despite Core Property Capital already having an agreement with Appfolio, Jun aims to showcase Entrata's accounting solution and its integration capabilities, and invited Ashley to a Braves game to build rapport and offered to visit her office.

calls.title: Call with Core Property Capital - Ashley Nichols
calls.brief: Jun spoke with Ashley from Core Property Capital, who revealed they are locked into a three-year Appfolio contract, delaying their plans to fully transition to Entrata. Despite this setback, Ashley is open to exploring Entrata's accounting capabilities and a potential buyout of the Appfolio contract, with a follow-up call scheduled for next Friday to discuss this further, and a potential in-person demo in Atlanta in mid-May.

Nate explored the potential for expanding Entrata's services to 2B Residential's other properties, while Shawna clarified the need for individual agreements per property due to their third-party management structure. calls.title: PMI / Entrata - Intro
calls.brief: Nick, Kayla, Matthew and Wheeler from Entrata, along with Robert from Premier Management, LLC (Provident Companies), discussed Provident's need for a new property management software due to security concerns and limitations of their current system, FHA Simply. Robert expressed interest in Entrata's AI capabilities and unified platform, but emphasized the importance of a smooth onboarding process and affordable housing expertise, particularly regarding Rural Development (RD) compliance, which is slated to be released in Entrata later this year. They scheduled a follow-up meeting for a high-level product walkthrough, focusing on AI features and pricing structure.

calls.title: BRG + Entrata Commercial Demo
calls.brief: Nate and David from Entrata, along with Rachel from BRG (Berger Realty Group), discussed the potential implementation of Entrata's software for BRG's properties, ultimately determining that the residential module would be a better fit due to BRG's lack of broker usage and the suitability of AI features for residential properties. calls.title: Rachel (BDR) <> Nate (Entrata) Sync
calls.brief: Nate from Entrata, along with Rachel from BRG (Berger Realty Group), discussed Entrata's capabilities for both commercial and residential properties, focusing on pricing, ROI, and specific features like dynamic pricing for renewals and CAM reconciliation. Rachel highlighted BRG's need for clear pricing and ROI figures to gain owner approval for a potential switch from Rent Manager, and they agreed on next steps including demos and proposal preparation. The conversation also touched upon Entrata's portal terminology and potential integration with BRG's arts and entertainment division.

calls.title: BRG + Entrata Accounting Demo
calls.brief: Nate and David from Entrata, along with Rachel and Zvonko from BRG (Berger Realty Group), discussed Entrata's property management software, focusing on its accounting capabilities and suitability for BRG's diverse portfolio, including accounting-only entities. Zvonko expressed interest in Entrata's ability to handle complex accounting scenarios, vendor management, and reporting, while also questioning its advantages over their current system, Rent Manager. The conversation concluded with a discussion of implementation, training, and the availability of test environments.

calls.title: BRG + Entrata Demo 2.0
calls.brief: Scott and David from Entrata, along with Rachel from BRG (Berger Realty Group), discussed Entrata's software capabilities for managing residential properties, focusing on resident screening, application processing, lease generation, and automated communication. Key highlights included Entrata's integrated platform to streamline operations, reduce manual work, and enhance resident experience, with a particular emphasis on the potential for significant time savings and revenue generation through features like automated insurance management and rent credit reporting. The conversation also touched upon Entrata's ability to handle complex accounting needs and customizable workflows, setting the stage for future discussions on specific implementation details and financial aspects.

calls.title: BRG + Entrata Demo
calls.brief: David, Nate and Scott from Entrata, along with Rachel from BRG (Berger Realty Group), discussed Entrata's software capabilities as a potential replacement for Rent Manager, focusing on improved reporting, lead management, and marketing integrations. Rachel expressed interest in Entrata's features and agreed to further demos, with a future discussion planned to explore pricing and potential revenue-sharing opportunities to offset costs. The goal is to present a strong business case to BRG's owner for transitioning to Entrata.

calls.title: Entrata - Berger Realty
calls.brief: Nate and Berkley from Entrata, along with Rachel from BRG (Berger Realty Group), discussed BRG's interest in transitioning from Rent Manager to Entrata for improved reporting, streamlined leasing processes, and a better website presence. Rachel's top priority is Entrata's reporting capabilities, specifically lease trade out reports and financial reporting, and she is open to exploring AI and other modern features. A product demo is scheduled to showcase Entrata's capabilities, starting with reporting, followed by the lease process and website features.

calls.title: Connor/Jesse: Kelson Transformation Plan
calls.brief: Connor from Entrata, along with Jesse from Kelson Group Property Management, discussed the potential benefits of switching to Entrata, focusing on quantifiable efficiencies and portfolio value increases. Connor presented a customized dashboard and ROI analysis, highlighting potential savings in leasing and maintenance, and offered a meeting with Entrata's professional services team to address concerns about the migration process, with the goal of securing Jason's approval for the switch. Connor also invited Jesse and Jason to Entrata's summit in Utah to meet the executive team and further explore the partnership.

calls.title: ELI+ Entrata AI Demo: Kelson
calls.brief: Libby, Connor and Nick from Entrata, along with Jesse from Kelson Group Property Management, discussed Entrata's AI-powered property management platform, focusing on leasing, maintenance, payments, and renewals, with the goal of automating administrative tasks and improving efficiency. Jesse expressed interest in the platform's capabilities and integration, particularly in comparison to their current systems, and acknowledged Entrata's potential value, though the final decision rests with Kelson's controller. Connor invited Jesse and Jason to the Entrata Summit to further explore the platform and its future direction.

calls.title: Entrata + Kelson: Accounting Demo
calls.brief: Connor, Nick and Libby from Entrata, along with Jesse from Kelson Group Property Management, discussed Entrata's accounting, reporting, and business intelligence capabilities, highlighting its advantages over Kelson Group's current Yardi system and in-house software, particularly in areas like automation, data integration, and AI. Jesse expressed strong interest in Entrata's advanced features, especially the amenity rent feature and AI tools, and the group agreed to schedule follow-up calls to discuss implementation and AI demos, acknowledging Kelson Group's potential future transition to Entrata.

calls.title: Entrata + Kelson: Overview Demo
calls.brief: Tyler, Libby and Connor from Entrata, along with Jesse from Kelson Group Property Management, discussed Entrata's integrated platform and its potential to streamline Kelson Group's leasing, resident management, and maintenance processes, addressing pain points with Rent Cafe. Jesse expressed interest in a follow-up demo focused on Entrata's accounting capabilities, highlighting the appeal of a centralized dashboard and modern technology. The call concluded with a plan to schedule a future demo to explore the accounting features in more detail.

calls.title: Connor/Jesse: Pre-Demo Call
calls.brief: Connor from Entrata, along with Jesse from Kelson Group Property Management, discussed Kelson Group's current tech stack, including Yardi and a custom in-house database, and explored potential improvements with Entrata's solutions, particularly in areas like task management, CRM, and lead handling. Jesse expressed interest in Entrata's smart task routing and AI capabilities, while also highlighting frustrations with RentCafe's implementation and Yardi's limitations. The call concluded with plans for a future Entrata demo and potential attendance at industry events.

calls.title: Strathmore - Entrata Demo/Lunch
calls.brief: Dallin and Rolanda from Entrata discussed the potential implementation of Entrata's property management platform with Antonia from Strathmore, focusing on streamlining leasing, application, and maintenance workflows, and replacing their current Yardi system and manual processes. They explored Entrata's features, including AI leasing assistance, integrated website functionality, and a centralized dashboard, and scheduled a follow-up meeting to discuss post-move-in processes. Dallin requested the total unit count for Strathmore's properties to determine pricing.

Legacy without the Bars expressed interest in Entrata's automation, AI capabilities, and comprehensive platform for streamlining operations and improving compliance.

calls.title: Entrata / Barnes Gold Management - Affordable Discussion
calls.brief: Kayla, Matthew, and Beaumon from Entrata discussed Alpha Barnes' affordable housing needs with John, focusing on compliance, file management, and potential Entrata solutions. They explored John's plans for outsourcing vs. in-house compliance, his interest in HFCS and PFCS projects, and scheduled a demo of Entrata's affordable housing platform for the tenth, thirteenth, or seventeenth, while also planning to connect at the upcoming TAA conference. Kayla offered to provide recommendations for compliance consultants.

calls.title: SRG: Entrata Procure to Pay Demo
calls.brief: Brandon and David from Entrata, along with Susan, Meghan and Jason from Sares-Regis Group, discussed Entrata's procure-to-pay process, focusing on vendor management, catalog punch-outs, and invoice processing, with the goal of understanding Sares-Regis Group's current processes and how Entrata can streamline them. The conversation also touched on Entrata's bill pay services, vendor access portal, and an invitation to connect at the upcoming AIM conference.

calls.title: Entrata – CRM & Marketing Follow-Up
calls.brief: David, Brandon and Chris from Entrata, along with Susan and Meghan from Sares-Regis Group, discussed Entrata's platform capabilities, focusing on marketing, CRM, AI-driven automation, and reporting, with the goal of consolidating SRG's current multi-system approach into a single platform. SRG expressed interest in Entrata's AI features, reporting capabilities, and potential for streamlining operations, while also inquiring about integrating Entrata's training courses with their existing learning management system. The Entrata team offered to explore this integration further and demonstrate how their platform could replace SRG's existing point solutions.

calls.title: Entrata- SRG Demo Sync
calls.brief: Chris and David from Entrata, along with Susan from Sares-Regis Group, discussed Entrata's platform capabilities, focusing on integration, reporting, and compliance, particularly in challenging states like California. They also explored the potential for Entrata's Learning Management System to serve as Sares-Regis Group's primary LMS and finalized details for an upcoming in-person meeting, including catering arrangements. The conversation also touched upon contract negotiations and the importance of demonstrating Entrata's value proposition for a successful partnership.

calls.title: Entrata- Annalise Pre Demo Sync
calls.brief: David from Entrata, along with Annalise from Sares-Regis Group, discussed Sares-Regis's potential acquisition of properties using Entrata and the upcoming in-person meeting to review Entrata's capabilities, focusing on migration processes, reporting, and AI integration. Annalise clarified Sares-Regis's current software usage, reporting needs, and interest in understanding migration options, while David highlighted Entrata's single-platform design and custom reporting services. The meeting aims to determine if acquired Entrata properties will remain on their existing instances or require a new Sares-Regis Entrata instance.

calls.title: Susan-Entrata Pre Demo Sync
calls.brief: Chris and David from Entrata, along with Jason from Sares-Regis Group, discussed a potential partnership where Sares-Regis Group would become an Entrata customer, exploring options for managing their 43,000 units across multiple platforms. Jason is evaluating Entrata's capabilities, particularly around regulatory compliance, construction cost tracking, and data integration, while also considering Yardi's pricing advantages due to their large unit count. The decision hinges on pricing and the value Entrata can demonstrate, with a 30-day turnaround expected.

LMS is looking to transition now, before they grow to a larger portfolio.

calls.title: Meeting with JJ Hyde
calls.brief: JJ from Entrata, along with Stacy from MDI Management, discussed pricing options for Entrata's implementation, including a potential revenue share model for rent reporting, and the need for references to secure Dave's approval. Stacy requested a one-pager on the revenue share option and emphasized the urgency of implementation before the busy season, while also jokingly requesting a clause ensuring JJ's continued support. They also scheduled a scoping call and addressed Stacy's concerns about pricing and the contract review process.

calls.title: Entrata + MDI 3.0 Maintenance & Utilities
calls.brief: JJ, Gerry, and Rolanda from Entrata discussed Entrata's utility management, maintenance, and reputation management solutions with LLC, focusing on how the platform can streamline processes, reduce workload, and improve resident satisfaction. The LLC representative expressed interest in the potential benefits but emphasized the need to convince the owner before adopting Entrata, particularly given Oregon's challenging utility regulations. The call concluded with an offer for further demos and appreciation for the insights provided.

calls.title: Pricing Conversation Entrata + MDI
calls.brief: JJ from Entrata, along with Stacy from MDI Management, discussed pricing for Entrata's products, including AI-driven solutions and core services, and potential cost savings by consolidating services like Reputation Advisor and Entrata Academy Elite. They explored various implementation and migration options, potential discounts, and the possibility of delayed billing to align with MDI Management's existing contracts, with Stacy planning to present a proposal to Dave after gathering necessary data. The conversation also touched on utility billing services and concluded with personal anecdotes about country living and eggs.

calls.title: Entrata + MDI 3.0
calls.brief: Brandon and Rolanda from Entrata, along with Stacy from MDI Management, discussed Entrata's accounting and reporting functionalities, including invoice processing, bank reconciliations, journal entries, and customizable reports, as well as AI-powered virtual assistants for leasing, renewals, payments, and maintenance. MDI Management explored how Entrata could streamline their accounting processes, automate tasks, and improve reporting capabilities, with a focus on addressing specific challenges like prepaid rent allocation and delinquency management.

calls.title: MDI + Entrata 2.0
calls.brief: Rolanda and JJ from Entrata, along with Natalie and Stacy from MDI Management, discussed Entrata's features for lead management, resident lifecycle, and delinquency handling, with MDI Management expressing interest in automation and customization. MDI Management raised specific questions about rent control compliance, partial payment handling, and integration with existing processes, while Entrata highlighted the system's capabilities and offered to investigate complex scenarios. The call concluded with plans for future demos focusing on accounting and maintenance, and a request from Entrata to quantify potential time savings with their system.

calls.title: MDI + Entrata  Demo 1
calls.brief: JJ and Rolanda from Entrata, along with Natalie from MDI Management, discussed Entrata's property management software, focusing on its dashboard, CRM, marketing website capabilities, and AI-powered leasing tools. The conversation highlighted Entrata's potential to automate MDI Management's manual processes, improve lead tracking and communication, and provide robust reporting for accountability, with plans for future demos on specific functionalities like the lead-to-lease process and accounting. Key areas of interest included the system's ability to streamline operations, enhance resident communication, and offer advanced screening and deposit alternative options, while also addressing specific Oregon state regulations.

calls.brief: Connor from Entrata discussed migrating the real estate forum's data to its own Entrata instance, emphasizing configuration flexibility and a phased approach to BI implementation. They explored options for system setup, data migration, and the potential for AI-driven automation to improve efficiency and reduce costs, with a focus on a September/October transition. The next steps involve a demo of Entrata's current offerings and a meeting with the migration and AI teams to optimize the forum's operating system.

calls.title: CLC + Entrata: Application Incentives Call
calls.brief: Craig, Connor and Vanessa from Entrata, along with Shaun and Nick from Campus Living Centres, discussed how to accurately display rent pricing and concessions on their website and lease documents. The primary challenge was ensuring the advertised net effective rent was visible to prospects without altering the base rent on the official lease, leading to a discussion on Entrata's pricing transparency features and charge code configurations. They explored solutions involving monthly specials, promo codes, and concession setups to reconcile the discrepancy between marketing materials and legal lease agreements.

calls.title: Forum/CLC + Entrata Sync
calls.brief: Connor from Entrata, along with Shaun and Nick from Campus Living Centres, discussed challenges with Entrata's functionality regarding promo codes and concessions, specifically how to display net effective rent during the application process without impacting the lease document's face rent or the ledger. They also addressed a long-standing feature request to separate document upload requirements for applicants and guarantors to streamline the application process. Connor committed to investigating solutions and escalating the feature request to Entrata's product team.

calls.title: Fortiva + Entrata Sync (Details + Packages + Pricing + Incentives)
calls.brief: Evan from Entrata, along with Adrian from Fortiva Residential, discussed Fortiva's decision to move forward with Yardi due to significantly lower pricing and a more comprehensive package, including revenue management, AI, and implementation. Adrian indicated that Entrata would need to match Yardi's pricing and implementation terms to be considered, but also expressed concerns about Entrata's long-term investment in R&D and accounting capabilities compared to Yardi.

calls.title: Fortiva + Entrata (Demo #2)
calls.brief: David and Evan from Entrata, along with Princess, Ricarda and Adrian from Fortiva Residential, discussed Entrata's comprehensive property management software, focusing on its lead-to-lease process, maintenance management, accounting features, and insurance solutions. Key highlights included Entrata's ability to automate marketing cost tracking, streamline application and screening processes with AI assistance, manage unit turns efficiently, and offer integrated financial tools for AP and month-end closeouts. The discussion also touched upon Entrata's robust customer support and onboarding process, aiming to provide Fortiva Residential with a holistic technology solution.

calls.title: Fortiva Residential - Entrata (Demo # 1)
calls.brief: David and Evan from Entrata, along with Princess and Adrian from Fortiva Residential, discussed Entrata's platform, focusing on reporting, maintenance management, AI capabilities, and website integration, with Fortiva expressing interest in its potential to streamline operations and improve data visibility. Fortiva is interested in a future demo to cover lead-to-lease, resident management, and accounting, but the actual switch to a new system is still a long way off. Fortiva will contact Entrata next year to schedule a session covering the topics they didn't see in the demo.

calls.title: Entrata Demo Request
calls.brief: Evan and Athen from Entrata, along with Adrian from Fortiva Residential, discussed Fortiva's current technology stack and identified key areas for improvement, particularly in reporting, process automation, and policy enforcement. Adrian highlighted significant pain points with their existing software, AppFolio, especially concerning renewal management, pricing strategies, and maintenance tracking, expressing a strong need for more robust analytics and system guardrails. The conversation concluded with Entrata agreeing to provide tailored demos focusing on these critical areas to address Fortiva's operational challenges and expansion goals.

calls.title: Pedcor Homes Corporation // Entrata Web Demo
calls.brief: Nathan Smileye, Matthew and Jen from Entrata, along with Brandon and Dom, discussed potential integration models for Entrata's property management solutions with Pedcor's existing systems, focusing on marketing, leasing, resident management, and accounting. Pedcor is evaluating how Entrata can complement their proprietary technology and support their goal of a frictionless leasing experience, with a particular interest in Entrata's AI capabilities and unified customer experience. The next steps involve further exploration of specific integration points and potential API development.

calls.title: Pedcor // Entrata Pricing and Product Discussion
calls.brief: Tyler, Wheeler and Nathan from Entrata, along with Brandon from Pedcor Homes Corporation, discussed potential integration of Entrata's services with Pedcor's existing proprietary PMS, Blue Notch, focusing on a phased approach to improve resident experience and streamline workflows. Brandon is exploring plug-and-play solutions and is open to a full Entrata solution if it proves more efficient than their current system, with a decision expected after a consultant's evaluation in Q2. Entrata proposed a demo to showcase their platform and identify potential integration points, with a focus on a long-term partnership.

calls.title: Call with Wessex Management LLC - DIANE Wenk
calls.brief: Tyrus from Entrata contacted DIANE at Wessex Management LLC to discuss their property management software, highlighting its potential to automate processes and reduce fraud, particularly in light of DIANE's dissatisfaction with their current system, Remote Landlord and its integrated payment processor, ManageGo. DIANE expressed interest in Entrata's AI capabilities and integrated platform, and agreed to receive more information and schedule a follow-up conversation to explore how Entrata could improve efficiency and address specific pain points in leasing and accounts payable. The call ended with a plan to schedule a follow-up conversation to explore Entrata's capabilities further.

calls.title: Harrison & Lear | Entrata Pricing
calls.brief: Bryce from Entrata, along with Lyra and Gynette from Harrison & Lear, Inc., discussed Entrata's proposed software package, pricing, and implementation timeline, targeting a go-live date by the end of July or early August. They reviewed core features, potential add-ons like resident insurance and AI, and scheduled follow-up calls for insurance details and implementation scoping to finalize the agreement.

calls.title: Harrison & Lear | Demo Utilities & Accounting
calls.brief: Bryce and David from Entrata, along with Lyra and Gynette from Harrison & Lear, Inc., discussed Entrata's accounting and reporting capabilities, focusing on financial statements, utility billing, and custom reporting. They explored how Entrata could streamline Harrison & Lear's processes, particularly in areas where their current system, Rent Manager, falls short, and discussed the potential for Entrata to handle corporate accounting and construction cost accounting. The conversation concluded with plans for follow-up meetings to delve deeper into specific features and address any remaining questions.

calls.title: Harrison & Lear | Utilities Convo / Gerry Crooks
calls.brief: Bryce and Gerry from Entrata, along with Gynette and Lyra from Harrison & Lear, Inc., discussed Entrata's utility management services and their potential benefits for Harrison & Lear, Inc., focusing on cost savings, accurate recapture, and regulatory compliance. Harrison & Lear, Inc. expressed interest in exploring the solution further, particularly regarding financial reporting and cost implications for owners and tenants, and agreed to schedule follow-up meetings to review the financial aspects and involve Jonathan, the President, in the final decision-making process. Entrata will provide a presentation outlining their offerings and a Master Service Agreement for review.

calls.title: Harrison & Lear | Entrata Affordable Demo
calls.brief: Matthew, Kayla and Bryce from Entrata, along with Gynette and Lyra from Harrison & Lear, Inc., discussed Entrata's affordable housing platform and its potential integration with Harrison & Lear's portfolio, including conventional, commercial, and single-family properties. Harrison & Lear expressed interest in streamlining operations, particularly compliance and utility management, and consolidating their software solutions. Entrata proposed next steps including a utilities call and a scoping call to finalize pricing and implementation timelines, with a focus on addressing Harrison & Lear's immediate needs and future growth plans.

calls.title: Harrison & Lear | Entrata Affordable Discovery
calls.brief: Matthew and Bryce from Entrata, along with Gynette from Harrison & Lear, Inc., discussed Entrata's affordable housing solutions and Gynette's current property management challenges. Gynette detailed her company's portfolio of tax credit, tax bond, and HUD-related properties, highlighting her manual processes for tracking affordable units and compliance. The parties agreed to schedule a demo focusing on Entrata's affordable housing features, with a follow-up discussion on reporting and accounting.

calls.title: Harrison - Lear | Entrata Demo #2 - Accounting, Maintenance, Reporting
calls.brief: David and Bryce from Entrata, along with Gynette, Jonathan and Lyra from Harrison & Lear, Inc., discussed Entrata's maintenance, accounting, and reporting capabilities, including AI-powered features and automation, with a focus on how these could streamline Harrison & Lear's current processes. Harrison & Lear expressed interest, particularly in the maintenance and accounting features, and a follow-up meeting was scheduled to discuss Entrata's affordable housing solutions before moving on to pricing.

calls.title: Harrison & Lear | Entrata Core Demo
calls.brief: Bryce and David from Entrata, along with Gynette, Lyra and Jonathan from Harrison & Lear, Inc., discussed Entrata's lead-to-lease and maintenance capabilities as a potential replacement for Rent Manager, focusing on its unified platform and automation features. Harrison & Lear, Inc. expressed interest in the system's financial aspects, maintenance accountability, and affordable housing compliance features, leading to a follow-up demo scheduled for Monday to delve deeper into these areas. The goal is for Harrison & Lear, Inc. to make a decision within 90 days, with a potential go-live date in May or June.

calls.title: Entrata: Harrison-Lear Discovery
calls.brief: Berkley and Bryce from Entrata, along with Gynette and Lyra from Harrison & Lear, Inc., discussed Harrison & Lear's interest in switching from Rent Manager to Entrata due to its outdated features and inadequate maintenance capabilities. Harrison & Lear manages a diverse portfolio of multifamily, single-family, and commercial properties, and seeks a centralized, all-in-one solution to streamline operations, particularly maintenance and accounting, with a focus on improving the investor portal and reducing the number of logins required for staff. A demo is scheduled for the following week to showcase Entrata's capabilities, with a focus on maintenance features and accounting.

calls.title: Entrata + Pacific Living Accounting/Reporting Demo
calls.brief: JJ and David from Entrata, along with Chelsea from Pacific Living, discussed Meter Investments' transition to Entrata and Joanne's role in the process, highlighting the benefits of Entrata's integrated system and customizable features compared to their current struggles with Serco. The call focused on training resources, accounting setup, reporting capabilities, and vendor management, with Joanne expressing excitement about the potential improvements and efficiencies Entrata could bring to their operations. They also touched on a potential issue with a former Entrata employee now working at Serco.

calls.title: Pacific Living Scoping call (45min)
calls.brief: Callin and JJ from Entrata, along with Chelsea from Pacific Living, discussed the implementation process of Entrata's software for Pacific Living's 15 properties, including timelines, data migration, team structures, and training. The call focused on understanding Pacific Living's specific needs, particularly regarding accounting and the transition from existing management companies, to ensure a smooth and successful setup. Next steps involve Chelsea determining firm transition dates and Entrata providing a scope validation document and preparing for the implementation kickoff.

calls.title: Pricing Proposal Pacific Living + Entrata
calls.brief: JJ from Entrata, along with Chelsea from Pacific Living, discussed Entrata's software solutions for student housing, focusing on pricing, implementation, and revenue-generating ancillary products. They reviewed a bundled proposal, negotiated discounts, and addressed potential implementation timelines and operational needs, with a focus on streamlining processes and maximizing revenue for Pacific Living's properties. The conversation concluded with an agreement on next steps for implementation and a commitment to further collaboration.

calls.title: Entrata JJ / Chelsea Product Discussion
calls.brief: JJ from Entrata, along with Chelsea from Pacific Living, discussed implementing Entrata's software for Pacific Living's properties, including student housing features and utility management. They agreed on a phased implementation approach, focusing on a standard package for the largest property and SIEM-assisted migration for others, with pricing and further details to be discussed the following day. Pacific Living is expanding significantly, with plans to acquire more properties, making Entrata's integrated platform a potentially cost-effective solution.

calls.title: Pacific Living + Entrata 3
calls.brief: David and JJ from Entrata, along with Chelsea from Pacific Living, discussed Entrata's maintenance app, accounting features, and reporting capabilities as a potential replacement for Yardi. Chelsea expressed interest in the user-friendliness of the maintenance app, the automation of accounting processes, and the customization of reports, particularly the ability to add manager notes. They agreed to a follow-up call to discuss product alignment and pricing, with the goal of receiving a proposal by the end of the month.

calls.title: Pacific Living + Entrata 2
calls.brief: David and JJ from Entrata, along with Chelsea from Pacific Living, discussed Entrata's comprehensive property management platform, highlighting its advanced CRM, automated leasing and resident portals, robust delinquency management with AI assistance, streamlined renewal processes, integrated utility expense management, and efficient maintenance and inspection tools. Key takeaways included Entrata's ability to automate complex tasks, provide real-time data visibility, and offer significant revenue-generating opportunities through features like rent credit reporting and deposit alternatives, all within a user-friendly, integrated system. The conversation concluded with scheduling a follow-up demo to delve deeper into maintenance and accounting functionalities.

calls.title: Pacific Living + Entrata 1

Chelsea expressed interest in Entrata's ability to streamline operations, reduce vendor reliance, and improve training and efficiency, particularly in contrast to her experience with Yardi. The conversation concluded with scheduling a follow-up to delve deeper into accounting and reporting features.

calls.title: Entrata // Chelsea w/ Meter Investments

calls.title: Entrata & PAC: Weekly Call
calls.brief: Shombree from Entrata, along with Kortney, Chris, Kym, Paul, Mark and Anna, discussed action items including support tickets, API updates, and issues related to fees, lead sources, and SMS messaging. They also addressed the need for a refresher on the watch list, potential system workflows for early bird pricing, and a RentPlus cancellation issue during property dispositions. Shombree will follow up on outstanding items and Annie will lead the next call in her absence.

calls.title: Entrata & PAC: Weekly Call
calls.brief: Shombree and Annie from Entrata, along with Kym, Anna, Mark, Chris and Marie, discussed updates on several tickets and the upcoming standard release featuring new AI agents within OXP. They also covered the activation of the rental history watch list, including training and informational materials for LivCor staff, and confirmed the leasing center and Snapped are live for certain properties. Entrata will coordinate with LivCor's training team to provide resources on the watch list feature.

calls.title: Entrata & PAC: Weekly Call
calls.brief: Abbie, Annie and Shombree from Entrata, along with Kortney, Anna, Paul, Chris and Kym, discussed several key issues including a duplicate ILS amenities ticket, a negative rent amenity issue, and the integration workflow with Jetty. They also addressed the timing of marketing material distribution for Rentplus and explored options for lead source mapping during migrations. Additionally, Paul sought assistance in finding a specific unit details report, and the conversation touched upon Entrata's development focus on AI and CRM capabilities.

calls.title: Entrata & PAC: Weekly Call
calls.brief: Shombree and Annie from Entrata, along with Chris, Kym, Anna, Paul and Mark, discussed scheduling a follow-up meeting to review the performance of 75 West and the new Snapped integration, ultimately agreeing on a date for the meeting. The conversation also covered several support tickets, including a bug with "Founders Village, Blue Moon with the pets" and a website setup issue with a cookie banner, and concluded with Shombree presenting customer success benchmarks for lead-to-lease conversion, neglected leads, maintenance requests, message center statistics, and online payment percentages, highlighting LivCor's strong performance in most areas.

calls.title: Entrata & PAC: Weekly Call
calls.brief: Shombree from Entrata, along with Paul, Tara, Chris and Kym, discussed several key issues including a persistent Blue Moon problem, the upcoming R2 release for drip campaigns and customizable triggers, and a significant issue with contact point event results impacting LivCor's operations. They also addressed bot lead management, a request to exclude specific charge codes from full payment requirements, and the need to disable duplicate cookie banners and resolve duplicate ILS amenities. Shombree committed to investigating these items and providing updates.

calls.title: Entrata & PAC: Weekly Call
calls.brief: Annie, Shombree and Cecille from Entrata, along with Mark, Anna, Kym, Paul, Tara, Gad, Chris and Kortney, discussed several pressing issues including SFTP data import problems, Snapped product performance, ID verification implementation, and a malfunctioning quick search feature. They also addressed feature requests for NSF notifications and explored options for improving rent reminder processes, as well as website transitions for newly acquired properties and call routing for the leasing center. Finally, they discussed issues with termination fees and the possibility of automating inspection triggers based on financial delinquency.

calls.title: Entrata & PAC: Weekly Call
calls.brief: Shombree from Entrata, along with Chris, Paul, Kortney and Kym, discussed API integrations, fee scheduling discrepancies, and data extraction for unit availability. Shombree committed to addressing the reported issues, including prioritizing a fix for the fee scheduling problem and investigating options for extracting unit availability data, and will be out of office from January 9th to the 21st. Paul also requested that Shombree prioritize updating the LCP 360 tour integration to their newest standard on the Entrata side.

calls.title: Entrata & PAC: Weekly Call
calls.brief: Shombree and Cecille from Entrata, along with Kym, Chris, Tara and Catlen, discussed website banner display issues related to cookie acceptance, discrepancies in the user interface across properties, and API token errors following email address updates. They also addressed the resolution of a Blue Moon error ticket, the availability of a help center favorites feature, and scheduled a future call to discuss fee transparency. Finally, they touched on contract updates for new properties and the team's availability during the upcoming holidays.

calls.title: LivCor | Entrata - Follow Up - concessions set up and configuration
calls.brief: Cecille, Robert and Devon from Entrata, along with Michael and Chris, discussed concession configurations, reporting accuracy, and the impact of charge code selections on financial reporting. The team clarified how to handle corrections to concessions already posted to the ledger, emphasizing the importance of aligning front-end data entry with back-end reporting to avoid discrepancies and ensure accurate net effective rent calculations. They also agreed to use an "other miscellaneous income" code instead of "concession other" for offsetting charges to avoid unintended impacts on concession reporting.

calls.title: LivCor | Entrata - Follow Up on $0 Rent Issue
calls.brief: Devon and Cecille from Entrata, along with Michael Wynn, Michael Wynn and Akshay from LivCor, discussed discrepancies in concession reporting due to manual ledger entries bypassing the standard workflow in Entrata. They explored potential solutions, including adding a column to the fact charge table to identify manual concessions and requested a timeline for implementation, with Devon committing to follow up with his team and Cecil regarding the feature request and its ETA. The group also acknowledged the need for LivCor to address internal operational procedures to prevent direct ledger entries and ensure accurate concession tracking.

calls.title: LivCor | Entrata - Follow up re: Null values for Rangewater to Entrata transactions
calls.brief: Robert, Paul, Cecille and Devon from Entrata, along with Akshay, Srini and Michael, discussed data discrepancies related to zero-dollar rents and missing concessions, focusing on identifying the correct data sources and methods for accurate reporting. They addressed issues with data from Rangewater and PAC, and explored a one-time fix for missing concessions by importing offsetting transactions, ultimately deciding to consult with Chris Harris to ensure proper accounting and data integrity in CoreDW. The group agreed to a follow-up meeting to continue resolving the data issues.

calls.title: Entrata & PAC: Weekly Call
calls.brief: Cecille, Shombree and Annie from Entrata, along with Kym, Gad, Kortney, Paul and Chris, discussed several pressing issues including resolving support tickets, addressing concerns about Section 8 acceptance information, and expediting merchant account setups. They also covered updates on cloning processes for new assets, the status of recent releases, and ongoing migration efforts, with a focus on prioritizing urgent tasks before the holiday break. The team also discussed the need for a user guide for setting up schedule a tour widgets without REd.

calls.title: Entrata & PAC: Weekly Call
calls.brief: Shombree and Annie from Entrata, along with Maegan, Mark, Chris, Anna and Marie, discussed the December ninth standard release, including new features like unified email logins and concession displays, and requested LivCor's testing and feedback. They also addressed the possibility of migrating historical ledger transactions from Yardi to Entrata, and the status of SMS requests and property migration pre-validations, including missing phone numbers needed for leasing center dashboards.

calls.title: PAC | Entrata Academy Demo
calls.brief: Cecille, Jen and Nick from Entrata, along with Kortney, Kym and Marie from Preferred Apartment Communities, discussed Entrata Academy Elite as a potential replacement for Grace Hill, focusing on its features, course content, and integration capabilities. Jay from Preferred Apartment Communities provided extensive feedback on the need for more sales and customer service training, AI-driven course recommendations, and enhanced reporting features, while also inquiring about course creation options and accessibility features. The group agreed to follow up on outstanding questions and schedule a future meeting to discuss implementation plans.

calls.title: Entrata & PAC: Weekly Call
calls.brief: Shombree from Entrata, along with Maegan, Kym, Kortney, Chris, Gad and Mark, discussed several key issues including a merchant account problem, a custom merge field request, and the need for improved data tracking and reporting for property features. They also addressed fee transparency challenges due to a lack of integration between Entrata and InGrain, and explored options for recording outbound calls to tenants. Shombree committed to investigating these issues and providing updates, while also informing the team of her upcoming unavailability and offering alternative support options.

calls.title: Kevin/Kayla/Alex - Affordable Updates/AI Chat

They explored potential AI integrations, addressed concerns about job displacement and data privacy, and scheduled a follow-up meeting to showcase Entrata's latest developments and discuss implementation strategies. Kevin also shared his experience with Lease AI and the upcoming rollout of Rent Cafe with Yardi.

calls.title: Entrata / Companion Associates Accounting Demo
calls.brief: Wynton, Jon and Tijah from Entrata, along with Austin, Kellie and Lynn from Companion Associates, discussed Entrata's capabilities as a potential replacement for RealPage, focusing on accounting, accounts payable/receivable, asset tracking, and job costing. Companion Associates expressed interest in Entrata's automation, reporting, and integration capabilities, particularly regarding construction accounting and vendor management. A follow-up meeting was scheduled to delve deeper into job costing and potential revenue generation through utilities and insurance.

calls.title: Entrata // Companion Associates resident Management Demo
calls.brief: Jon, Vincent, Wynton and Tijah from Entrata, along with Austin and Jennifer from Companion Associates, discussed Entrata's post-lease resident management features, focusing on automation, efficiency, and integration capabilities as a potential replacement for RealPage. Companion Associates expressed interest in Entrata's features, particularly the resident-friendly ledger, automated delinquency management, and facilities app, while also raising concerns about support responsiveness and the learning curve associated with a new system. The call concluded with a plan for a follow-up accounting demo and further discussion of utilities and insurance.

calls.title: Companion Associates / Entrata Marketing+Leasing Demo
calls.brief: Vincent, Wynton, Tijah and Jon from Entrata, along with Austin and Jennifer from Companion Associates, discussed Entrata's software as a potential replacement for OneSite, focusing on its user-friendliness, single database architecture, and AI capabilities. Jennifer, a property manager with extensive experience, expressed frustration with OneSite's downtime and a preference for Yardi, while Austin, the broker in charge, emphasized the importance of efficient lead management and responsiveness. The group scheduled a follow-up demo to explore move-in and resident management workflows.

calls.title: Entrata & Crestline -Accounting and Finance Walkthrough
calls.brief: Jon, Dallin and Seth from Entrata, along with Christine and Jim from Crestline Communities, discussed Entrata's accounting and finance capabilities, including vendor management, invoice processing, journal entries, reconciliations, budgeting, and reporting, with a focus on how Entrata could improve Crestline Communities' current processes. Christine, Crestline's controller, initially had audio issues and was unfamiliar with Entrata, but became engaged as the demonstration progressed, and a follow-up meeting was scheduled to explore resident management and property manager workflows.

calls.title: Entrata & Crestline Marketing/Operations Walkthrough
calls.brief: Dallin and Seth from Entrata, along with Jim and David from Crestline Communities, discussed Entrata's platform, focusing on its marketing, lead-to-lease, and website management capabilities, with a demonstration of the dashboard, AI features, and customization options. Jim expressed interest in the financial back-end operations for a future meeting with his accounting team, while David focused on lead attribution and website customization. Entrata will follow up with Crestline Communities to schedule a meeting with the accounting team and provide additional information on website traffic reports and DocuSign integration.

calls.title: Lunch Zoom with Jim & Dallin for Entrata Overview
calls.brief: Justin and Dallin from Entrata, along with Jim from Crestline Communities, discussed Crestline's current software challenges with Yardi, particularly its complexity and lack of integration, and explored how Entrata's single-platform solution could address these issues. They also touched upon Crestline's growth plans and Jim's upcoming vacation to Cabo, ultimately scheduling a follow-up demo focused on Entrata's marketing and operational capabilities.

calls.title: HCA/Entrata Homebody Products and Q&A
calls.brief: David, Chris, Brandon and Cassie from Entrata, along with Tina, Ana and Blanca, discussed integrating Homebody renters insurance and related products into the Entrata dashboard, focusing on features like Deposit Alternative, Renters Insurance, Homebody Rewards, and rent credit reporting. Entrata offered a three-year initial contract term, addressed concerns about arbitration jurisdiction and payment fees, and provided assistance with a cost analysis template to facilitate HCA's decision-making process regarding the product bundle.

calls.title: HCA/Entrata- Scoping and Implementation Overview
calls.brief: David and Callin from Entrata, along with Tina and Christina from HCA Residential (Hanken Cono Assad & Co.), discussed the implementation process of Entrata's software, focusing on timelines, team structure, data migration, and training, with HCA expressing a preference for a phased rollout starting later in the year. HCA is considering Entrata to replace Amsi, their current software, and is particularly interested in a smooth transition and comprehensive support. The call concluded with action items for both parties, including finalizing pricing and scheduling a demo of Entrata's resident-facing product.

calls.title: Entrata + HCA: Executive Accounting Demo Series
calls.brief: Gerry, Chris, David and Brandon from Entrata, along with Tina Barnett, Tina Barnett and Blanca, discussed Entrata's budgeting, reporting, utility management, and rent control features, focusing on how these tools can streamline HCA Residential's workflows and improve efficiency. HCA expressed interest in the integrated utility program, customizable reporting, and rent control settings, with plans to further explore renters insurance options in a separate meeting. The overall goal is to reduce manual tasks for the accounting team and enhance the resident experience through a single, integrated platform.

calls.title: Entrata- HCA Executive Accounting Overview and Q&A
calls.brief: David, Cory and Brandon from Entrata, along with Tina Barnett and Tina Barnett from HCA Residential (Hanken Cono Assad & Co.), discussed Entrata's platform, focusing on financial reporting, accounting functionality, and procure-to-pay system, with a demonstration of how Entrata's single login, single database platform could replace their current systems. HCA Residential expressed interest in a future deep dive into the accounting aspects with their team, but requested to postpone further discussions for a few months due to year-end and budget cycles. Entrata agreed to resend the financial packet and follow up to schedule the next steps, potentially an in-person meeting.

calls.title: HCA- Entrata Product Package
calls.brief: Cory and David from Entrata, along with Tina from HCA Residential (Hanken Cono Assad & Co.), discussed pricing for Facilities Pro and Entrata's new rent control feature, as well as potential flexibility in setup costs for year-end deals. HCA Residential is viewed Entrata favorably and requested a hands-on trial, and Entrata offered a guided sandbox environment; they also discussed the MSA review process and next steps, including a call with Colin Baker to address implementation concerns.

calls.title: Chorus - Entrata- Quick Chat
calls.brief: The Entrata team (David and Phone Caller #2) spoke with Tina to prepare for an upcoming demo to her company's executive team, who are considering switching from Amsi to either Entrata or RealPage. Tina highlighted the team's interest in Entrata's all-in-one system and confirmed their timeline for a decision and rollout, while also raising concerns about pricing and ancillary revenue models. The Entrata team addressed these concerns and emphasized their commitment to a smooth implementation process and a good fit for both organizations.

calls.title: Jeff + Brennan | Sync
calls.brief: Jeffrey from Entrata, along with Brennan from ERA Management, discussed Entrata's upcoming R1 release featuring AI-powered automation and its potential impact on ERA Management's operations, particularly in utilities management and insurance administration. Brennan expressed interest in exploring these features further at the upcoming conference, focusing on how Entrata's platform can streamline processes and integrate with ERA's existing systems, especially regarding their captive insurance program. They also touched on reviewing the MSA and clarifying associated fees before the conference.

calls.title: Entrata + ERA | Terms and Final Steps
calls.brief: Scott and Jeffrey from Entrata, along with Brennan from ERA Management, discussed ERA Management's decision to postpone transitioning to Entrata due to internal instability and a shift in immediate business needs, despite Brennan's positive impression of Entrata's software and potential long-term benefits. Entrata expressed understanding and offered to revisit the conversation in the future, emphasizing the potential for a partnership once ERA Management stabilizes and is ready to scale. Brennan committed to staying informed and maintaining open communication.

calls.title: Entrata + ERA | Pricing Proposal
calls.brief: Jeffrey from Entrata, along with Brennan from ERA Management, discussed a potential partnership where Entrata would provide its property management platform to ERA Management, including a delayed billing start date to accommodate ERA's existing contract with Outfolio. The offer includes a comprehensive suite of services, potential revenue-sharing opportunities, and a 60-month term, with Brennan planning to discuss the proposal with his partners before a follow-up meeting to finalize the agreement.

calls.title: Entrata + ERA | Scoping Discussion
calls.brief: Callin and Jeffrey from Entrata, along with Brennan from ERA Management, discussed the implementation process of Entrata's software, including timelines, data migration strategies, and the resources required from ERA Management. Brennan expressed concerns about data migration timing and the need to avoid disruptions during peak seasons, while Callin outlined Entrata's support and training resources, and the conversation concluded with a tentative plan to revisit the timeline after internal discussions at ERA Management. The call also covered specific aspects of ERA Management's portfolio, such as single-family homes, mixed-use properties, and affordable housing carve-outs, to tailor the implementation approach.

calls.title: Entrata + ERA | Demo and Discussion
calls.brief: Jeffrey, Jon and Rolanda from Entrata, along with Brennan from ERA Management, discussed ERA Management's potential transition from AppFolio to Entrata, focusing on Entrata's business intelligence and commercial property management capabilities. Brennan expressed interest in Entrata's superior reporting, scalability, and automation, particularly for commercial properties and future growth, while also considering contractual obligations and implementation complexities. The call concluded with plans for a follow-up meeting to discuss implementation and pricing, aiming to provide Brennan with the information needed to make a decision with his partners.

calls.title: Better Housing Coalition | Entrata Affordable Demo
calls.brief: Vincent, Matthew and David from Entrata, along with Tovah and Robin from Better Housing Coalition, discussed Entrata's capabilities for managing affordable housing properties, including program setup, lead-to-lease workflows, and reporting, with a focus on how Entrata's system could improve efficiency and compliance compared to Better Housing Coalition's current Yardi system. Better Housing Coalition expressed interest in a future demonstration of Entrata's accounting and maintenance features, with a follow-up meeting scheduled for April 13th to explore these areas further.

calls.title: Better Housing Coalition | Entrata Core Demo
calls.brief: Bryce, David, Matthew and Kayla from Entrata, along with Tovah and Michelle from Better Housing Coalition, discussed Entrata's "Lead to Lease" functionality, emphasizing its all-in-one platform capabilities and user-friendly interface. Key highlights included the system's robust CRM, automated marketing tracking, customizable reporting, and advanced AI features for lead engagement, with a particular focus on how these can benefit both market-rate and affordable housing properties. The conversation also touched upon deposit alternatives, integrated screening processes, and the potential for future discussions on utility management and maintenance modules.

calls.title: Better Housing Coalition | Entrata Affordable - Discovery
calls.brief: David, Matthew and Bryce from Entrata, along with Tovah from Better Housing Coalition, discussed Better Housing's needs and how Entrata's platform could address them, particularly focusing on affordable housing features and user experience. Key pain points identified with their current Yardi system included difficulties with rent updates, form management, and user onboarding, which Entrata aims to solve with its integrated platform. The teams agreed to schedule separate demos for Entrata Core and the affordable housing component to showcase the lead-to-lease process, compliance workflows, and potential AI integrations.

calls.title: Entrata // Better Housing Coalition - Discussion
calls.brief: Vincent, Oscar and Bryce from Entrata, along with Tovah from Better Housing Coalition, discussed the potential for Better Housing Coalition to switch from Yardi to Entrata, focusing on Entrata's affordable housing capabilities and CRM features. Tovah expressed dissatisfaction with Yardi's performance and support, and is considering a move to Entrata, with a target implementation timeframe of Q3 or early Q4 2027, pending internal discussions and budget planning. A demo showcasing Entrata's affordable housing features and benefits is scheduled for the week of the eleventh, with Robin, Better Housing Coalition's systems expert, also in attendance.

calls.title: Entrata + Q10
calls.brief: Ryan from Entrata, along with Rosi from Q10 Property Advisors, discussed Q10's frustrations with their current property management software, ResMan, and integrated platforms like Apartments247 and Elise AI, highlighting issues with data synchronization, reporting inaccuracies, and inefficient workflows. Rosi expressed a need for a fully integrated system that eliminates workarounds, streamlines processes, and improves communication, particularly in areas like website management, CRM, applications, payments, maintenance, budgeting, and utilities. They also touched on the importance of accurate reporting for demanding ownership and the need for a better purchase order system and vendor insurance compliance process.

calls.title: Entrata + Q10 Affordable
calls.brief: Matthew, Kayla and Ryan from Entrata, along with Rosi and Michelle from Q10 Property Advisors, discussed Q10's current manual processes for affordable housing within ResMan, highlighting significant time spent on manual data entry and reporting. Entrata presented their platform's capabilities to streamline these processes, particularly in rent limit enforcement and compliance reporting, with a planned on-site demonstration in March to showcase these benefits and address Q10's concerns about technology adoption. The conversation also touched upon Q10's operational goals, which prioritize survival and mastering existing systems over new initiatives in the upcoming year.
